messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: prod /v1/stream p99 latency breach detected in eu-west-1 — p95 jumped > 2x; p99 > 3s. Paging oncall.

Ben (oncall): seeing this too. p95 went from ~120ms to ~850ms over the last 6m, p99 spiked to ~3.2s. Error rate small (~0.18%) but streaming stalls visible in traces. Noticed a calibration job for int8/auto-quant finished ~00:14 UTC.

Alice (infra): thanks Ben. Can you drop the rage metrics and top traces? Which model(s) affected?

Ben (oncall): most traffic hitting redwood/base-7b-int8 (hosted), but fallback to base-7b-fp16 also exists. High correlation with requests that use long prefix KV (chat sessions > 2k tokens). Attaching a sample span:

```
trace_id: 0x8f1b...
span: inference/serve -> kv_cache_lookup (duration 1.8s)
logs: "kvcache_miss=true dequant_lock_wait_ms=1200 calib_step=finalize"
```

Carla (ML runtime): that log line smells like contention in dequant/KV cache during int8 dequant path. We rolled a new int8 calibration profile to hosted yesterday (autocalib v2). Might be a calibration fallout for certain long-context workloads.

Dinesh (serving): I'm looking at node-level metrics. There are several GPUs showing elevated GPU memcpy wait and host-side stalls. CPU thread dump shows a few threads stuck in dequant conversion while holding KV locks.

Maya (support): any customer impact right now? Eli, can you coordinate CS?

Eli (customer-success): we've received 2 PD reports (low-level) about streaming stalls from EU customers. No escalations yet but one customer's pipeline showed timeouts at 5s. Preparing a short note.

Ben (oncall): immediate ask: Can we mitigate by routing traffic away from int8 variant to fp16 for affected routes/keys? If yes, do it and we'll watch metrics. Also consider disabling the autocalib rollout.

Alice (infra): Ack. Running routing tweak now. Command: 

```
# route traffic for /v1/stream in eu-west-1 to fp16 fallback
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west-1 --route "/v1/stream" --model redwood/base-7b-fp16 --weight 100
```

Alice (infra): applied. Starting 10s warmup.

incident-bot: ACTION: routing update applied by Alice (infra) at 00:25:12 UTC. Observability: streaming p95/p99 in eu-west-1 will be recalculated.

Carla (ML runtime): I'm disabling the autocalib job in hosted control plane — preventing further profile changes.

Dinesh (serving): I also pushed a config to reduce KV cache lock hold-time (experimental): 

```
serving.runtime.kv_lock_timeout_ms=50  # was 200
serving.runtime.dequant_batch_size=8   # reduce dequant per-thread work
```

Dinesh (serving): will monitor for increased CPU but should reduce tail waits.

Ben (oncall): visible improvement: p95 down to ~300ms within 45s of routing change, p99 down to ~900ms. Stalls reduced but still elevated vs baseline.

Maya (support): sending customer note: "We're investigating increased streaming latency in EU; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. ETA for next update 30m." :thumbsup:

Eli (customer-success): queued a proactive heads-up to affected accounts, offering a temporary SLA credit if they hit timeouts.

Carla (ML runtime): quick postmortem plan: 1) rollback/disable the autocalib profile permanently for hosted until we validate on long-context workloads 2) run synthetic long-prefix load tests against int8 profile 3) instrument dequant lock times and KV cache contention in more granularity 4) evaluate per-request quantization gating (disable int8 for sessions > X tokens).

Ben (oncall): agree. Also propose a short-term rule: block int8 auto-rollout for any model that serves streaming endpoints until we have guardrails.

Alice (infra): created a temporary ACL: 

```
# block autocalib rollouts for streaming routes
redwoodctl autocalib disable --tag streaming-endpoint --until 2026-04-01
```

Dinesh (serving): I've opened a hotfix PR to make KV lock yielding more aggressive; will run canary on 2 nodes in eu-west-1. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/1987

Carla (ML runtime): longer-term: we should add calibration shadow runs + perf regression checks for tail metrics (p99 on large prefix). This slipped because perf checks were focused on mean/median.

Ben (oncall): updating incident severity: SEV-2 (customer-facing but mitigated). Logging timeline for postmortem.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled. Ben -> Alice at 00:40 UTC.

Ben (oncall): handing off primary for follow-up to Alice. I'll stay in loop for customer comms.

Alice (infra): taking lead. Current status: routing to fp16, autocalib disabled, KV lock timeout lowered, canary hotfix running. Next update in 20m unless things change.

Maya (support): any change to customer-facing errors? We're still seeing occasional requests hitting retry logic but timeouts mostly stopped. Sending follow-up to affected customers now.

Eli (customer-success): customers acknowledged the mitigation. One customer requested an RCA and timeline for when int8 can be safe again.

Carla (ML runtime): for the RCA: initial hypothesis = autocalib produced an int8 weight layout that causes longer dequant conversions combined with KV cache lock ordering changes for long-context requests. Those two factors amplified tail latency. We'll capture exact calibration commit, inputs, and failing token sequences.

Dinesh (serving): note for ops: if we see recurring tail >1s after rollback, escalate to SEV-1. For now, keep monitoring dashboards and traces.

Alice (infra): metrics check at 00:52 UTC: eu-west-1 p95=180ms, p99=520ms. Still above steady-state but much better. Rolling this incident into oncall follow-up board.

Ben (oncall): thanks team. Handing final notes to Alice. I'll update rotation with the summary.

Alice (infra): recording action items: [AUTOCALIB-ROLLBACK], [HOTFIX-KV-YIELD], [PERF-SHADOW-TESTS], [CUSTOMER-RCA]. Assigning owners: Carla, Dinesh, Carla/Eli, Maya respectively.

Maya (support): closing customer-facing interim note. Will await RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: SEV-2 -> mitigated. Channel: #incidents. Please follow standard postmortem template and tag eng-runtime/eng-ml.

Carla (ML runtime): I'll take postmortem lead. Expect draft within 48h.

Eli (customer-success): will attach timelines and customer impacts to the postmortem doc.

Ben (oncall): last call — any lingering tasks?

Dinesh (serving): I'll keep the canary hotfix running and promote if stable.

Alice (infra): closing thread for active paging. Reopen if p99 climbs >1s. Great coordination everyone. :pray:
